title: Merchant Vessel Wreckage
description: Splintered planks and torn sailcloth litter the shallows where a merchant vessel broke apart. Crates bob in the knee-deep water, their contents spilling out with each wave. The wreck is fresh enough that gulls still circle overhead.

choices.label: Gather the timber
choices.description: Plenty of serviceable wood floats within easy reach.

outcomes.text: You wade in and drag out armloads of good timber. Enough to keep any craftsman busy for days.
The best planks are waterlogged but usable. A decent haul for minimal effort.
An undertow catches your legs as you reach for a floating plank. You fight free but take a battering against the rocks.

choices.label: Search for valuables
choices.description: A merchant ship means merchant coin, scattered among the debris.

outcomes.text: A strongbox wedged under the keel still holds a merchant's travel purse. Lucky find.
Scattered coins glint among the debris. You gather what you can before the tide shifts.
The wreck groans and shifts as you search. A falling mast section clips your shoulder before you roll clear, clutching a fistful of coins.

choices.label: Collect the rope and sinew
choices.description: Kelp-woven rigging makes excellent binding material.

outcomes.text: The rigging is tangled but strong. You cut away generous lengths of kelp-woven cord.
Most of the rigging is frayed beyond use, but you salvage enough to be worthwhile.
A line snaps taut as you pull it, whipping across your hand and leaving a raw welt. The kelp sinew is good quality, at least.
